supplementary_explanations.explanation: The shipped checker requires the exact substring 'DIVERGING = ['. Actual source uses 'DIVERGING   = ['. AST parsing verifies the complete named palette with the exact expected values; no source or raw finding was changed.

The shipped regular expressions do not evaluate figsize=(183/25.4,...). Safe AST arithmetic gives 183 mm for both source declarations. Exported PDF/PNG widths are separately measured because bbox_inches='tight' changes the physical crop.

pdfplumber char['size'] is a vertical bounding-box measure: for a 90-degree label it can equal the glyph advance width (e.g. the 7pt letter i is reported as 1.554). Font-size compliance uses actual PDF Tf values from pypdf visitor_text, multiplied by the text and graphics matrix scale. Raw pdfplumber minima remain recorded for transparency.
Any lexical warning is caused by words such as 'bars' in prose. AST contains no bar/barh/boxplot call; the figures use points/intervals and empirical CDFs.

The shipped legend detector only searches 30 characters after .legend(. Both calls use bbox_to_anchor later in their arguments. The hash-bound current PNG review confirms external bottom legends; future renders need a new visual review.

observations: Viewed the actual current 3-column by 3-row dot/interval figure. Eleven method/configuration rows are present in consistent order, including assembly and chains versions of both BackFlip-2.1 and BackFlip-1.
Blue/ochre/teal semantic colors are visible. Direct method labels and marker shapes supplement color.
No title, row-label, axis-label, or external-legend overlap/clipping was observed at the inspected image resolution.
ANM/GNM absolute-MAE cells visibly say relative score; TCR-pMHC points are shown without independent-family confidence intervals.
The longer BackFlip row labels fit without observed collision or clipping. Some intervals are smaller than their markers; this is not evidence that intervals are absent.
This is an eleven-completed-entry progress snapshot. Partial FastProtFlex and other unfinished models are absent from the primary figure, rather than being compared on smaller surviving subsets.

The updated footer visibly reads '11 completed entries · same 3,063 records · mixed training exposure'. It fits on its own line without observed collision with axes or the bottom legend; it does not imply matched training exposure.
Viewed the actual current three-panel empirical-CDF figure. Titles, axes, and the external bottom legend are visible without observed clipping.
The five displayed methods are FlexPPI, BackFlip-2.1 assembly, BackFlip-2.1 chains, DynaProt-M, and ANM. The five-entry, two-row external legend fits without observed clipping.
The learned-baseline curves share an ochre family color but have solid/dashed/dotted styles visible in the actual figure. Direct legend labels identify each; ANM is teal with a distinct dash pattern.
Single-chain curves partly overlap; no local zoom or nonlinear axis is used. No color-vision simulation or paper printout was inspected.
